name: coolify-vscode-dashboard
description: Deploy, monitor and manage your Coolify apps, databases and services from the VS Code sidebar. Each repo shows its own Coolify project, with live build logs and Cloudflare Access support.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In untrusted folders the dashboard still works, but the pre-deploy command and local services from the folder's settings are ignored.

coolify.serverUrl.markdownDescription: Address you open Coolify at, e.g. `https://coolify.example.com` or `http://localhost:8000`. `/api/v1` is added for you. The API token is saved securely; set it with **Coolify: Open Settings**.

enumDescriptions: Coolify API token only (direct connection or a plain reverse proxy).
Coolify API token + Cloudflare Access service token (CF-Access-Client-Id / CF-Access-Client-Secret).
Coolify API token + your own extra headers (other auth proxies).
coolify.authMode.description: How requests reach your Coolify server.

coolify.allowSelfSignedCerts.markdownDescription: Accept self-signed or otherwise untrusted HTTPS certificates. Only turn this on for servers you control (homelab, LAN, localhost).

coolify.requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout for each Coolify API request.

coolify.projectUuid.markdownDescription: Coolify project shown for this folder. Leave empty to auto-detect from the folder's git remote. Set it in **Workspace** settings (`.vscode/settings.json`) to share the choice with your team. Use **Coolify: Select Project for This Folder** to pick from a list.

coolify.environment.markdownDescription: Optional: only show one environment of the project (e.g. `production`). Empty shows all environments, grouped.

coolify.refreshIntervalSeconds.description: How often the dashboard refreshes while it is visible. While a deployment is running it refreshes every 5 seconds.

coolify.statusBar.enabled.description: Show a running/total count for the current project in the status bar.

coolify.confirmDeploy.description: Ask for confirmation before deploying, stopping or restarting.

coolify.deployRisk.pendingBar.markdownDescription: Show a **pink** bar on apps that build this repo when they have changes that are not deployed yet: newer commits on their branch, unpushed commits or uncommitted files. Only files inside the app's Coolify *Base Directory* / *Watch Paths* count.

coolify.deployRisk.stopUsersCheck.markdownDescription: Turn the bar **red** ("stop users") when the pending change would disturb people using the running app: new SQL migrations that lock or rewrite tables, drop or rename columns, etc., or files matching your downtime rules. Add `-- coolify:safe` to a migration to skip it.

coolify.deployRisk.migrationGlobs.markdownDescription: Where your SQL migrations live (glob patterns). Empty = common locations: `**/migrations/**/*.sql`, `**/migrate/**/*.sql`, `**/db/migrate/**/*.sql`, `prisma/migrations/**/migration.sql`, `supabase/migrations/*.sql`, `drizzle/**/*.sql`.

coolify.deployRisk.downtimeRules.markdownDescription: Your own "needs downtime" rules: when a pending change touches a matching file, the bar turns red with your reason. Example: `[{ "pattern": "docker-compose.yml", "reason": "recreates all containers" }]`

coolify.preDeploy.command.markdownDescription: Command to run locally before every deploy, e.g. `npm run build` or `npm test`. If it fails, the deploy is stopped (you can still choose *Deploy anyway*). Empty = off.

coolify.preDeploy.cwd.markdownDescription: Folder to run the pre-deploy command in, relative to the workspace folder (e.g. `web`). Empty = workspace folder.

coolify.preDeploy.timeoutMinutes.description: Stop the pre-deploy command if it runs longer than this.

coolify.merge.enabled.markdownDescription: Show a **Merge & Deploy** button on apps that build the target branch. It merges the source branch into the target branch, pushes, then deploys.

coolify.merge.sourceBranch.description: Branch that gets merged (e.g. development, staging).

coolify.merge.targetBranch.description: Branch that receives the merge and is deployed (e.g. main, production).

coolify.merge.remote.description: Git remote used for fetch and push.

coolify.localServices.markdownDescription: Local dev servers shown in the **Localhost** section, each started in its own terminal. Example: `[{ "name": "Web", "command": "npm run dev", "cwd": "web", "port": 3000 }]`

command.description: Command to run, e.g. npm run dev.

cwd.description: Folder relative to the workspace folder.

port.description: Port the service listens on (used to show running/stopped).

url.description: URL to open. Defaults to http://localhost:<port>.

scripts.lint: eslint src test scripts media esbuild.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:leaks && npm run check:secrets
